name: Agency hero: an orthographic exploded diagram of the five layers of a build, lifting whichever layer you point at
notes: Signature effect: five 2:1 isometric plates that separate once on load, bottom up, then respond when the visitor points at any layer's name. Deliberately NOT CSS 3D: no perspective, no cursor tilt, no preserve-3d, which is what keeps it distinct from section 0026. It is flat SVG with hand-authored rhombus paths, so it renders identically everywhere and costs nothing to animate. The control surface is a real list of buttons beside it, not the diagram, which means hover, focus and tab all drive it for free and the content is readable text rather than 20 unlabelled paths. Touch has no hover, so a tap latches a layer and a second tap releases it. Important if you edit the art: the viewBox is fitted to the measured getBBox (104 -10 312 506), not a round number. The original 0 0 520 470 clipped the bottom plate and wasted 240 units of dead space. Re-measure after moving anything. Part of the ten hero 940Digital brand series (sections 0027 to 0036); the series log, the contact sheet that renders all ten live, and the written recommendation are in brand-heroes/set-evidence/. Unlike the client-derived sections in this library, this one is NOT de-identified: 940Digital is Owen's own business, so there is no third party to protect and the real wordmark, palette and copy are the point of the section. Brand rules baked in across the whole series: display type at weight 500 with about -0.03em tracking (not 700); #3194E0 never carries text on a light background because it measures 2.90:1, so blue text on sand is #1F6FB0 and a blue fill takes a charcoal label at 5.18:1; every figure is JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums; text containers are sized in ch, not px.
